insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options (vary by plan): 5/7.5/10/15/20/25/50/75/100/200 Lakhs (as per Annexure C plan chart)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room rent limit shall be At Actuals unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: Room rent is paid at actuals with no category cap, allowing you to choose any room without limits. This provides maximum flexibility and minimizes out-of-pocket expenses.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The Secure Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: An additional sum insured called Secure Benefit activates after your base sum insured is used up. This offers extra financial protection during large or multiple claims.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: The restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness for which an admissible claim has been paid during the Policy Year and also for any other Illness covered under the Policy.
great.explanation: Sum insured restoration can be used multiple times for the same illness within the policy year. This means better coverage for recurring treatments without losing restored benefits.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 60 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately prior to the date of admission.
great.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered for up to 60 days before hospital admission. This helps cover diagnostic tests and treatments leading up to hospitalization.

great.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 180 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately post the date of discharge from the Hospital.
great.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for up to 180 days after discharge. This supports longer recovery periods with follow-up treatments and medicines.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: This Cover will be applied irrespective of number of claims made under the expiring Policy.
great.explanation: No-claim bonus does not reset to zero even if you make claims, allowing your sum insured to grow over time. This rewards claim-free years and improves coverage.

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with us.
great.explanation: A 24-month waiting period applies for specified illnesses and treatments. This is a standard industry practice to prevent immediate claims on pre-existing or specific conditions.

great.name: Air Ambulance
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify expenses incurred by the Insured Person during the Policy Year towards Ambulance transportation in an airplane or helicopter for Emergency Care...
great.explanation: Air ambulance expenses are covered if you opt for this add-on as per your plan. This provides emergency transport by air in critical situations.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.
good.explanation: A 30-day initial waiting period applies for all illnesses except accidents. This is a common waiting period in health insurance policies.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage...
good.explanation: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months, which is within the normal industry range. Some plans may offer shorter waiting periods as per the schedule.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Year on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
good.explanation: Treatment taken at home when hospitalization is not possible is covered. This is useful for certain medical conditions requiring home care.

good.name: AYUSH Treatment
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred by the Insured Person only for Inpatient Care under Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy systems of medicines... up to the Sub-limit specified against this Cover in the Policy Schedule
good.explanation: AYUSH inpatient treatments are covered but subject to a sub-limit specified in the policy schedule. This supports alternative medicine treatments within limits.

good.name: Optional Add-ons
good.quote: my: Optima Secure offers following Add on Covers: 1. my: health Critical Illness Add On... 2. my: health Hospital Cash Benefit Add On... 4. Unlimited Restore (Add on)... 5. Optima Wellbeing (Add on)...
good.explanation: You can customize your policy with optional add-ons like critical illness cover, hospital cash, unlimited restore, and OPD packages. These enhance your coverage if you choose to buy them.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure B- Items for which Coverage is not available in the Policy (Non-Medical Expenses)... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ...
bad.reference: Annexure B, Pages 49-50; Section B.2.3 Protect Benefit, Page 15-16
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables and non-medical items like gloves and masks are excluded by default, causing out-of-pocket expenses. Coverage for these is only available if the Protect Benefit add-on is purchased.

bad.name: NCB
bad.quote: 1.8 Cumulative Bonus ... Optima Secure: Not Covered
bad.explanation: The Optima Secure plan does not offer cumulative bonus, reducing your sum insured growth on renewal. This limits benefits compared to plans that provide renewal bonuses.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.explanation: The policy defines co-payment but does not clearly state if or when co-pay applies by default. You should check your policy schedule or insurer to confirm if any co-pay is applicable.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
